# Context Vault

> Local-first asset vault for AI coding sessions: immutable content-addressed snapshots, honest bidirectional Codex⇄Claude Code migration, native Antigravity `.db`/WAL reader, token ledger & real-time quota monitor, code-aware weighted BM25 + optional dense RRF retrieval with lineage folding (-87% index size, O(1) incremental dedup), temporal memory with manual CRUD/pinning and conflict superseding (stale-memory intrusion 0.0), budgeted five-slot handoff brief, MCP backend (with `budget_tokens`), AML Add/Search adapter (tenant isolation + `request_id`/409 idempotency + `Dockerfile.aml`), optional Ollama/LLM semantic refinement, and a reproducible 162-query ablation benchmark. Pure Python stdlib, zero dependencies, all data stays on the machine.

Rules for agents using this tool: never modify source session files (read-only); migration is dry-run by default — write to real session dirs only with explicit `--apply` after showing the user the diff; every memory cites its source snapshot — verify important decisions by re-reading the snapshot; the resident service on 127.0.0.1:8791 is an accelerator only, file-scan fallback returns identical results.

## Quick Start

- `pip install -e .` — optional zero-dep install registering global `cv`, `cv-mcp`, `cv-aml` commands (or run `python tools/cv.py ...` directly)
- `cv setup --mcp [--mcp-clients a,b]` — one-shot onboarding: init vault → sync all local agents → sync ledger → extract memories → register MCP clients
- `cv serve --open` — start local web console + hot-index HTTP API + unified `/aml/add`, `/aml/search` at `http://127.0.0.1:8791`

## Commands

- `cv doctor` — environment check (Python, session sources, DSH Zstd backend, MCP summary, vault DB)
- `cv sync [--debounce]` — incremental intake across Claude Code / Codex / ZCode / Antigravity / DeepSeek Harness (`dsh` V4/Zstd)
- `cv export <session-file> [--redact]` — snapshot a session (idempotent, content-addressed; `--redact` or `CV_REDACT_SECRETS=1` masks common secrets)
- `cv migrate <file> --target codex|claude|antigravity|dsh|markdown` / `cv import --agent <src> --target <tgt> [--no-skip-migrated] [--apply]` — single-session or full-harness batch migration with honest diff, same-origin & `migrations.jsonl` dedup, and per-item fault isolation (dry-run by default; `--apply` writes real dirs)
- `cv skills list|inspect|migrate|remove|backups|rollback` — cross-agent `SKILL.md` inventory, unified-diff preview, bulk migration, auto-backed removal & verified rollback across ZCode / Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Cursor / DeepSeek Harness (Web Console enforces `connected_only=1` aligned with MCP connections)
- `cv ingest <file> [--format X]` / `cv export-harness <sid> --to X` — bridged read/write via `session-migrate` (18 formats)
- `cv memory extract|search|list|dedup|compile-rules` — temporal memory (decisions/preferences/pitfalls/constraints; active-only by default, `--history` traces superseded chains, `--project`/`--since`/`--kind` filtering, `compile-rules` builds sentinel-protected `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md`/`.cursorrules`)
- `cv semantic status|setup|refine|titles` — optional Ollama / OpenAI-compatible embeddings (`vault/ai_config.json`), LLM memory refinement & session title cleanup
- `cv ledger sync [--recompute]` / `cv ledger quota [--window 5h|24h|7d|30d]` / `cv ledger export --format csv|markdown --window all` / `cv ledger stats` — local multi-client token ledger (including DeepSeek V4/Flash pricing), 5h cooldown ETA, real-time IDE/provider quotas & CSV/Markdown export
- `cv backup [--out DIR] [--keep N] [--list] [--verify [FILE]]` / `cv prune [--apply]` / `cv audit [--kind all|error|abnormal|switch|ok]` — consistent full-config + DB/snapshot zip backups, CRC+SQLite verification, daily retention GC & audit filtering
- `cv mcp install [--all|--client X|--clients a,b]` / `cv mcp uninstall [--client X|--clients a,b]` / `cv mcp status` — selective MCP management across claude/codex/cursor/antigravity/dsh (skips uninstalled residuals, writes `.bak-cv` backups)
- `cv-aml --serve` — standalone AML Add/Search HTTP server (or `Dockerfile.aml` on `0.0.0.0:8000`)
- `python benchmarks/run_bench.py` — reproducible 162-query ablation + noisy & streaming panels (CodingVault-Bench)

## MCP tools

- `vault_remember(query[, limit, kind, project, since, include_history, budget_tokens])` — long-term memory with `#id` and snapshot/time provenance (pinned-first, active-only by default)
- `vault_memorize(content[, kind, project, pinned, supersedes])` — persist a decision/constraint/pitfall/preference directly into `memory_items` (snapshots stay immutable)
- `vault_handoff([id, project, budget_tokens, include_memories])` — budgeted five-slot handoff brief bundled with active project memories
- `vault_context(query[, limit, project, agent, since, no_decay, budget_tokens])` — relevant history excerpts for the current task (bounded decay by default, `no_decay=true` to disable)
- `vault_search(query[, limit, project, agent, since, no_decay, budget_tokens])` — full-text search over all snapshots (bounded decay + `no_decay`)
- `vault_recent(limit)` / `vault_snapshot(id)` / `vault_stats()`

- [Releases](https://github.com/nghqqa/context-vault/releases): verification receipts (tests, real-machine checks)
